description: Search your conversations by what was said: transcripts, notes summaries, titles and participant names, by keyword and by meaning (e.g. 'pricing objections', 'what Dana said about net 45', 'Alice'). Returns up to 10 meetings and 20 transcript lines, best first, with the passage that matched and each Memory ID; call get_memory for the full transcript. For temporal queries (yesterday, last week, a specific date) use list_memories instead: it returns memories sorted newest-first with full dates.
name: search_conversations
